regions.region: page 1 full page: article header, title, authors, abstract, DOI and affiliations
regions.finding: The original page image contains metadata and an abstract-level summary only. No reaction arrow, table row, explicit experimental operation, or independent yield appears, so no reaction record is fabricated from this page.

unresolved: The abstract's aggregate claims do not identify experiment-level scales, times, yields, or structures.
Supporting Information is not supplied or associated.

regions.region: page 2 left column introduction and cited prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Prior carbometallation, C–H activation, and low chirality-transfer reactions are literature context with no uniquely specified current-paper run; they are not misclassified as new experiments.
Generic CMD/alkyne carbometallation and proposed reversed-insertion A/B pathways are represented as one mechanism/concept record, not a preparative experiment.

regions.region: page 2 right-column leaving-group and substrate-scope narrative
regions.finding: The prose identifies four leaving-group screen rows and introduces the Figure 3 scope, including the distinct 82% gram-scale 3aa repeat. These statements are linked to the row records visualized on page 3 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Optimization details said to be in Supplementary Table 1 were not associated or inferred.
Most scope operations and yield bases are absent from the main-text prose.

regions.finding: Four independent leaving-group screening experiments were read from the original image: methyl ether no reaction with recovered 1a; phosphate 8%, acetate 46%, and carbonate 76% by 1H NMR with CH2Br2.

regions.region: page 3 center/lower Figure 3 and footnotes a–i
regions.finding: Thirteen displayed product lines were retained row-wise, with the 3aa 80% standard run and 82% 7 mmol repeat separated. Footnote overrides for temperature, charges, catalyst amount, acetate substitution, and substrate identity were structured. The 3ca/footnote-c label conflict remains explicit.

regions.region: page 3 lower prose: compatibility, regioselectivity, directing groups and synthetic applications
regions.finding: The prose links Figures 4–7 across later pages and the 3fa X-ray assignment; it does not create duplicate experiments. The cited Supplementary Dataset/File was not imported.

unresolved: Figure 3 footnote c visibly prints 1a (1.3 mmol) while product 3ca maps to arene 1c.
Yield bases and most reaction times are not stated for Figure 3 rows.

regions.region: page 4 upper Figure 4 and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Seven functional-group-scope rows (3fa, 3ff, 3ga, 3hi, 3ij, 3al, 3am) were retained independently with shared charges and footnote-specific catalyst/substrate overrides.
Two distinct regioselectivity experiments were retained with 1.2 equiv arene, 0 °C, 23 or 36 h, 81% yield, and exclusive functionalization observations.

regions.region: page 4 bottom discussion and synthetic-application continuation
regions.finding: The text introduces Figure 8 mechanistic experiments and completes the Figure 7b description; cross-page evidence is linked to existing arrow records rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Reaction times, workups, product masses, and yield bases are absent for Figure 4 rows.
The X-ray/Supplementary File references were not treated as SI association.

regions.finding: Pyridine- and pyrazole-directed experiments were kept separate. The 1l run has two product-specific yields (3la 82%, 4la 4%) and printed gram charges; the 1m run gives 3ma in 85%.

Stepwise allenylation to bis-allene 5 and [4+2] conversion of 3aa to isoquinolinone 6 are two distinct transformations; their exact page-7 textual procedures enrich the same records without extending coverage.

The secondary-carbonate control gives B-type [4+2] product 7 in 12% after recrystallization, with desired A-type allene not formed. The preparation and proposed A/B insertion pathways are separate records.

unresolved: Several Figure 6/7 yields lack an analytical basis in the figure.
The Figure 8 non-detection limit is not reported.
Page-7/8 text is used only to complete experiments already introduced on covered pages.

regions.finding: Four chiral scope experiments were retained independently with exact shared charges, S-2f 98% ee, 0 °C, row yields, and 98% product ee by HPLC. S-3af absolute configuration is X-ray-based; the other assignments are by analogy.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left chirality-transfer, KIE and mechanism discussion
regions.finding: The parallel 1a/1a-D5 comparison was represented as two parallel steps in one KIE record (KIE about 2.1). The Int1–Int3/syn-beta-oxygen-elimination proposal is classified separately as mechanism; Figure 10 text on page 7 is context only.

regions.region: page 6 right-column Methods and beginning of Synthesis of 3aa
regions.finding: The exact 1.0 mmol 3aa preparation begins on this page and is merged with Figure 3's 80% standard row, preserving sequential room-temperature charging and a separate 0 °C/19 h reaction step. Page-7 text supplies only the continuation workup, purification, mass and yield.

regions.region: page 6 conclusion and general analytical methods
regions.finding: Conclusions and instrumentation context add no independent reaction row. Minor cycloisomerization is qualitative aggregate context without product/run mapping, so it is not converted into a fabricated yield record.

unresolved: Figure 9 does not report reaction times; three non-3af rows lack workup, mass, and yield basis.
Individual rates and yields for the KIE pair are absent.
The cited Supplementary spectra/datasets were not associated or imported.
